items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: I sent telegrams to every booking agent that I knew, even Joe Glaser

ctx.x: And we had a pretty catchy theme song, too. It was -- well, it was kind of one of the kind of tunes you like to listen to. It had a beautiful sound.

Beautiful sound, beautiful tone, and man, it was pretty, man. It just floated, see. And we stayed there, and our band was a big favorite in Cincinnati, big favorite. And I shall never forget, I sent telegrams to every booking agent that I knew, even Joe Glaser, there's a booking agent in Cleveland, Ohio, see. Because the band was ready. We thought the band was really ready for the big times. And nothing happened. That's life. Timing is -- it plays a most important part in one's life.
Well, that was in '38. That was in '38 and that's when Joe Glaser took over Louis Armstrong.
